name: Johnny
source:
A friendly, knowledgeable chef. He wandered the galaxy to add many recipes to his impressive repertoire. He has a mysterious air about him. For some reason he's always broke, often attributed to his poor money schemes.

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
